import Uorc.Uorc.Core.RuntimeMachineSemanticPrefixTests
open Uorc.Uorc.Core
namespace CurrentPrefixSnapshot

def observe (s : RuntimeMachineEngine.State) : List UInt64 :=
  [s.semanticLedger.semanticWork,s.semanticLedger.semanticStorageUnits,
   s.semanticLedger.peakSemanticStorageUnits,s.semanticLedger.outputBytes,
   s.semanticLedger.activeFrames,s.semanticLedger.peakFrames,
   s.semanticLedger.acceptedArchives,s.semanticLedger.basisObjects,
   s.usage.work,s.arena.nextHandle,s.arena.ownedBytes,s.arena.liveEntries,
   s.usage.peakOwnedBytes] ++
   (match s.frames with | [] => [0,0,0] | f::_ => [f.frame.nextInstruction,f.phase,f.semanticPosition])

def main : IO Unit := do
  let blocked ← match RuntimeMachineSemanticPrefixTests.blockedDivide 300000 with
    | .ok s => pure s | .error _ => throw (IO.userError "blockedDivide")
  unless RuntimeMachineSemanticPrefixTests.audit blocked do throw (IO.userError "blocked audit")
  IO.println s!"accepted_refusal={reprStr (observe blocked)}"
  let resumed := RuntimeMachineEngine.extendSemantic blocked (RuntimeMachineSemanticPrefixTests.semBudget 100)
  let failed ← match RuntimeMachineSemanticPrefixTests.settle 300000 resumed with
    | .ok s => pure s | .error _ => throw (IO.userError "settle")
  unless RuntimeMachineSemanticPrefixTests.audit failed do throw (IO.userError "failed audit")
  IO.println s!"accepted_retry={reprStr (observe failed)}"
  match RuntimeMachineSemanticPrefixTests.cleanup 300000 failed (RuntimeMachineSemanticPrefixTests.nonzeroLedger 15) with
  | .ok _ => IO.println "snapshot_cleanup_inventory_zero: pass"
  | .error _ => throw (IO.userError "cleanup")
end CurrentPrefixSnapshot

def main : IO Unit := CurrentPrefixSnapshot.main
